text:
I hear how heavy that pressure feels, especially when it's been compounded by a performance review that left you questioning your abilities. It makes complete sense that you're feeling stuck and overwhelmed right now.

You mentioned the pressure never seems to end and that the review has been affecting your confidence. Before we talk about switching jobs or anything else, could you tell me a bit more about what happened during that review last November? Was there specific feedback given, or did it feel more like general criticism? Understanding exactly what triggered the second-guessing might help us figure out if this is something that can be addressed in your current role or if it points to a different kind of fit elsewhere.
